entries.title: Psalms 77:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. On Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A Psalm.>> My voice is unto God, and I will cry; my voice is unto God, and he will give ear unto me.

entries.title: Psalms 77:2
segments: In the day of my trouble, I sought the Lord: my hand was stretched out in the night, and slacked not; my soul refused to be comforted.

entries.title: Psalms 77:3
segments: I remembered God, and I moaned; I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 77:4
segments: Thou holdest open mine eyelids; I am full of disquiet and cannot speak.

entries.title: Psalms 77:5
segments: I consider the days of old, the years of ancient times.

entries.title: Psalms 77:6
segments: I remember my song in the night; I muse in mine own heart, and my spirit maketh diligent search.

entries.title: Psalms 77:7
segments: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

entries.title: Psalms 77:8
segments: Hath his loving-kindness ceased for ever? hath [his] word come to an end from generation to generation?

entries.title: Psalms 77:9
segments: Hath *God forgotten to be gracious? or hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 77:10
segments: Then said I, This is my weakness: --the years of the right hand of the Most High

entries.title: Psalms 77:11
segments: ¶Will I remember, --the works of Jah; for I will remember thy wonders of old,

entries.title: Psalms 77:12
segments: And I will meditate upon all thy work, and muse upon thy doings.

entries.title: Psalms 77:13
segments: O God, thy way is in the sanctuary: who is so great a *god as God?

entries.title: Psalms 77:14
segments: Thou art the *God that doest wonders; thou hast declared thy strength among the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 77:15
segments: Thou hast with [thine] arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 77:16
segments: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they trembled, yea, the depths were troubled:

entries.title: Psalms 77:17
segments: The thick clouds poured out water; the skies sent out a sound, yea, thine arrows went abroad:

entries.title: Psalms 77:18
segments: The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind, lightnings lit up the world; the earth was troubled and it quaked.

entries.title: Psalms 77:19
segments: Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths are in the great waters; and thy footsteps are not known.

entries.title: Psalms 77:20
segments: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
